construction_secondary.role: Construction PPE, machinery and vehicle detection

hazard_auxiliary.role: Supplementary specialized hazard evidence; never accepted from one frame

action_pose.role: Real 17-keypoint COCO pose extraction for temporal action recognition

excluded_models.models/candidates/prodbykosta_person_yol: Excluded after a real project sample was classified as horse instead of person.

safety_rules.worker_precision: A Person seen by only one PPE/construction detector must be at least 70% confidence; two-model Person agreement may use the base person threshold.
safety_rules.helmet_safe: Require overlapping Helmet/Hardhat confirmation from BOTH PPE models and temporal confirmation in at least 3 of 5 inference frames.
safety_rules.vest_safe: Require overlapping Vest/Safety Vest confirmation from BOTH PPE models and temporal confirmation in at least 3 of 5 inference frames.
safety_rules.ppe_disagreement: Never mark SAFE when the PPE models disagree.
safety_rules.machinery: Use native construction_secondary machinery/vehicle detections first. If native full-frame machinery is absent, run real construction-model inference on overlapping horizontal tiles; only machinery candidates recurring in at least 3 of 5 analyzed frames may create dynamic equipment zones.
safety_rules.tiled_machinery_honesty: The tile path changes scale/context only. Class name and confidence remain direct construction-model outputs; no manual equipment label is introduced.
safety_rules.missing_ppe: Never infer missing PPE from a single absent positive detection. Prefer explicit negative class plus temporal evidence.
safety_rules.unsafe_behavior_auxiliary: fall_hazard, unsafe_ladder_use, phone-usage and no-fall-protection from the auxiliary detector require at least 3 positive observations in the last 5 inference frames.
safety_rules.sequence_action: Use real YOLO Pose + TSSTG over 30 tracked pose samples. Display only the seven model-native action names. Never rename an action as Entering Forklift.
safety_rules.fall_down_action: TSSTG Fall Down becomes a CRITICAL unsafe-action hazard only when pose coverage is at least 50% and action confidence is at least 50%.
safety_rules.auxiliary_false_positive_control: A single auxiliary-model hazard detection never creates a confirmed behavior incident.
safety_rules.geometry_clamp: Clamp the tracked worker foot point to image bounds before restricted-zone polygon tests.
safety_rules.distance: Worker-equipment distance is reported in pixels unless camera calibration/homography is configured; no uncalibrated meter claim is allowed.
